_doc: ROM locations of the dialog tables of src/code/bank_83/dialog.asm per release (24-bit LoROM addresses; layout only, no ROM content). pointers: aDialogPointers (dialog_count x ptr24 to the dialog texts, which start at the first bank of dialog_banks); option_vram: aTextDataTableFFFE (5 words); number_vars: aTextDataTableFFFC (112 x [ptr24, size]); text_vars: aTextDataTableFFFD (up to the pointer table, [ptr24, size] each). number_vars_shift: the WRAM relocation of the release (!RAM_SHIFT in src/common/region.asm), used to write the shared numeric variable table.
